title: Backups of {{name}}
explain: A backup stops the application, archives its files and its unit, and starts it again. The newest five are kept.
started: The backup was started. You will be notified when it is ready.
restoreStarted: The restore was started. You will be notified when it is done.
unverified: This archive has no digest, so it cannot be restored.

confirmRestore.title: Restore this backup?
confirmRestore.message: {{name}} will be stopped and its files replaced by this archive. If it does not answer afterwards, the previous files are put back.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this backup?
confirmDelete.message: The archive is removed from the disk. This cannot be undone.
